policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the SIRI page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. No excerpt text was typed: each is resolved from LINE NUMBERS out of a numbered dump by scripts/visa-registry/excerpts-from-lines.mjs, which fails the file unless both the display and lowercase forms occur literally in the normalized text. That tool exists because B-33 shipped four verbatim excerpts of the wrong sentences.
structure_note:
The pay limit is the whole scheme, and two things about it decide outcomes.

FIRST, WHICH SALARY COUNTS. The authority names exactly three admissible components — liquid assets, labour-market pension contributions, and paid holiday allowance — and then names the benefits that look like salary and are NOT counted: canteen, car, phone, internet, and housing. Publishing the threshold without the exclusion list would let someone add DKK 60,000 of housing to a DKK 500,000 offer and believe they qualify.

SECOND, THE JOB-SEEKING TRAP. Losing the job revokes the permit, and a job-seeking permit must be applied for NO LATER THAN TWO DAYS after employment ends. Two days is short enough that a reader who learns it late has already missed it. Work is forbidden during that period, which is the opposite of what 'job seeking permit' suggests to most readers.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateline. Its body states the 2026 pay limit explicitly ('The minimum amount for 2026 is DKK 552,000') and says the amount is regulated every 1 January, so the figure carries its own year and the next revision is visible as a text change. The daily sync is what will notice it.
not_extracted: The step-by-step application walkthrough (create a case order ID, pay the fee, complete AR1, employer completes their part). It is procedure for using SIRI's portal rather than a requirement of Danish law, and it changes with the portal.

The document checklists. The page publishes two — a general one and a separate, longer one for employment in hotels and restaurants — and they are extracted for no route in this batch. Publishing one and not the other would imply the hospitality checklist does not exist.
The rules for accompanying family members, which the authority describes on its own pages and which are a separate route.
Sideline employment, commuting, and external-examiner work, each of which the page links out to as a separate permit with its own conditions.

requirements.label: Annual salary must meet the pay limit — DKK 552,000 for 2026
requirements.description: The single defining condition of the scheme, with the year it applies to and the date it is re-set.

requirements.label: No educational background or professional field is required
requirements.description: What distinguishes this scheme from the Positive Lists, stated by the authority rather than inferred from their absence.

requirements.label: Only three salary components count towards the pay limit
requirements.description: The admissible components, quoted with the sentence that scopes them.

requirements.label: Canteen, car, phone, internet and housing do NOT count towards the pay limit
requirements.description: The exclusion that decides borderline cases. Without it the threshold reads as reachable by adding benefits.

requirements.label: Unpaid holiday does not lower the threshold, and holiday allowance counts in the year it is paid
requirements.description: Two timing rules on the same figure, quoted together because the authority states them together.

requirements.label: Salary must be paid into a Danish bank account in your own name
requirements.description: The account must be in the applicant's own name at a bank legally operating in Denmark.

requirements.label: The Danish bank account must be opened within 180 days
requirements.description: All three cases in one sentence: granted abroad, entering after grant, and already holding a permit valid 180 days or more.

requirements.label: The offered salary must correspond to Danish standards
requirements.description: A second, separate salary test: meeting the pay limit does not satisfy it.

requirements.label: Terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards
requirements.description: Holiday entitlement and notice periods, assessed by the regional labour market councils where SIRI is in doubt.

requirements.label: Working hours must be at least 30 hours a week
requirements.description: A part-time job at the full salary does not qualify.

requirements.label: The job must not be encompassed by a legal labour conflict
requirements.description: Quoted whole, because the same sentence carries the exception for other jobs at an affected employer.

requirements.label: A Danish authorisation is required for regulated professions
requirements.description: Applies before the permit can be granted, not after arrival.

requirements.label: An accompanying family member must not have had a permit revoked more than once for lacking a work permit
requirements.description: A condition on the MAIN applicant's permit that depends on a family member's history, which is easy to miss.

requirements.label: Processing fee
requirements.description: Payable before the application is submitted, to cover SIRI's case processing.

requirements.label: Normal processing time, and the longer time if information is missing
requirements.description: Both figures quoted together, because the one-month figure alone reads as a commitment.

requirements.label: One month before starting work — but only if you declare you can support yourself
requirements.description: Fourteen days without the declaration. The consequence sits in the same sentence as the condition.

requirements.label: Four-year permit where the employment is four years or longer
Shorter employment gives a permit for its duration, plus an automatic 6-month job-seeking permit
You are not allowed to work during the job-seeking period
requirements.description: The rule that most contradicts what the permit's name suggests.

requirements.label: A residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the passport expires
requirements.description: A short passport silently shortens the permit.

requirements.label: Apply for a job-seeking permit no later than two days after employment ends
requirements.description: The shortest deadline on the page, and the one a reader is most likely to learn too late.

requirements.label: Losing the job revokes the permit
requirements.description: Stated plainly by the authority; the six-month job-seeking permit is the remedy, not an automatic continuation.

requirements.label: You must support yourself and may not receive benefits under the Active Social Policy Act
Giving up your Danish address or staying abroad over 6 successive months lapses the permit
The permit does not allow work in other Schengen countries
A sideline job requires a separate permit
As a general rule the employer must be a company registered in Denmark
requirements.description: Quoted with the exception the authority states in the same sentence.
